description_en: Queries semantic knowledge related to a user question
description_zh: 查询与用户问题相关的语义知识
name: QuerySemanticKnowledge

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass it explicitly with --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The knowledge graph name. Call listGraphs first to retrieve available graphs
parameters.help_zh: 图谱名称，可先调用 listGraphs 获取
parameters.name: graph_name

parameters.help_en: The digital human name. Call listAuthorizedAgents first to retrieve the list of USE permissions
parameters.help_zh: 数字员工名称，可先调用 listAuthorizedAgents 获取 USE 权限列表
parameters.name: agent_name
